title: Awesome
text: Awesome. Normally I cannot do thousand pc puzzles But This 1 is sorted into 24 sections In each day you open a box And you get 42 little pieces to put together. They are all a complete square that connects to the other one, and by doing it this way it is a lot easier to complete the puzzle. The pc are very nice and thick and fit together very well. They do not get loose if you need to move it. It also comes with a very large poster. Would make an awesomely great gift !!!!
